description: What the main window is allowed to do, on every platform. App commands are plain #[tauri::command]s and need no extra permission; plugins (opener, updater) are only used from Rust, so the page gets none of their permissions. Anything beyond core:default has to be added here deliberately. close and destroy: the close guard (onCloseRequested asks while desktops are open, then destroys). set-title: the window title. show, hide, set-focus: bringing the window forward, and on macOS ⌘W hiding it (hideWindowOnClose). The title bar's window controls are in desktop.json (Windows, Linux), the menu bar in macos.json.
